why: Closes slot 1's arc into a full ring. Tempting, and wrong twice over: a solid ring is indistinguishable from the SHIPPED default, so the one slot a player is most likely to be would give them no marker at all; and 'the unbroken one is player 1' is a rule that has to be explained rather than seen, which is the failure the whole issue is about. Slots 2-4 are untouched, so every count assertion still passes -- caught only by the leaves-a-gap-even-at-one case, which measures the angular span of the single run. RE-POINTED by issue #778: the literal 0.28 moved to `MARKER_ARC_GAP` in presentation/identity-marker.ts so the HUD glyph breaks its ring at the same places the arena does. The mutation is unchanged in what it proves -- it still closes slot 1's single arc into a solid ring -- and is still applied at the arena's use of the constant rather than at the constant itself, because a shared value set to zero would take the HUD strip with it and kill cases in two layers for one defect.
